name: LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) Conceptual Design Report
notes: 278 pages; submitted to the Department of Energy as documentation for the CD-1 management process.

summary.plain: The first full design description of LZ, written to win US Department of Energy approval for the project.
summary.technical: LZ CDR (arXiv:1509.02910, LBNL-190005, September 2015): conceptual design of a ~10 tonne liquid xenon second-generation WIMP detector at SURF, sensitive from a few GeV/c² to hundreds of TeV/c².
